summary: Encore Capital Group filed an 8-K to announce a private offering of $325 million senior secured floating rate notes due 2033, upsized from $300 million, priced May 13, 2026. The notes accrue interest at three-month EURIBOR (0% floor) plus 3.250% per annum. The offering is exempt from SEC registration under Rule 144A and Regulation S. No strategic transaction, acquisition, or special situation is involved; this is a routine debt capital markets financing. Watch for potential impact on leverage ratios and note trading performance, but no event-driven or risk-arb angle applies.
